findings.evidence: Lines 50–52 open `TauCeti` and then `Padic`; lines 55 and 77 declare lemmas whose explicit arguments are `ℚ_[p]ˣ` and `ℚ_[p]`. Mathlib already defines the relevant API as `Padic.mulValuation`, `Padic.norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation`, and related declarations in `Mathlib/NumberTheory/Padics/PadicNumbers.lean`.
findings.fix: Close `namespace TauCeti` before opening `namespace Padic`, and qualify TauCeti definitions and supporting lemmas where needed.
findings.issue: Opening `namespace Padic` inside `namespace TauCeti` places the new public lemmas in `TauCeti.Padic`, although `toAdd_normalizedValuation_eq_valuation` and `normalizedAbsoluteValue_eq_nnnorm` take Mathlib's `ℚ_[p]` (or its units) and belong in its existing `Padic` namespace.

summary: The public p-adic comparison API is nested under `TauCeti.Padic` instead of the existing Mathlib `Padic` namespace, preventing the intended type-oriented placement.
